jobs.title: Vice President, Project & Program Management
jobs.description:
AECOM is seeking a Vice President, Project & Program Management to lead business growth, client engagement, operational performance, and delivery of complex capital programs and projects across the New York metropolitan area. The role will focus primarily on public agency clients, with private-sector relationships and experience considered a strong advantage.
Position Responsibilities:
- Provide executive leadership for AECOM’s New York Program and Project Management business, balancing market growth, client service, project delivery, financial performance, and staff development.
- Build a culture of leadership, accountability, collaboration, technical excellence, and professional development through active coaching and mentoring.
- Drive profitable, collaborative growth of Program Management and Construction Management services across infrastructure, transportation, buildings, aviation, water, housing, education, and other capital markets.
- Coordinate portfolio priorities, staffing plans, work-sharing, and resource assignments to provide clients with the appropriate expertise at the appropriate time.
- Lead and support multidisciplinary teams throughout planning, design, procurement, construction, commissioning, turnover, and closeout.
- Develop and implement Program Management Plans, Project Execution Plans, governance structures, decision frameworks, and delivery procedures.
- Oversee project scope, schedule, budget, risk, quality, safety, commercial performance, and client satisfaction across multiple concurrent assignments.
- Promote consistent project delivery practices, including work planning, monthly project reviews, forecasting, corrective action, and lessons learned.
- Oversee operating budgets and portfolio performance in coordination with business line leadership.
- Recruit, develop, engage, and retain high-performing staff; support succession planning and leadership development across the practice.
- Lead a sizable team through direct and indirect supervision and collaborate across AECOM offices, business lines, and technical disciplines.
- Perform other responsibilities consistent with the role and business needs.

Business Development & Market Leadership:
- Develop and execute the New York market strategy for Program and Project Management services in alignment with AECOM business priorities.
- Lead client discovery, capture planning, strategic pursuits, proposals, interviews, and negotiations for major opportunities.
- Identify and advance new opportunities with existing and prospective clients, including alternative delivery, PMO, program controls, owner’s representative, and construction management assignments.
- Contribute to account planning, pipeline development, go/no-go decisions, teaming strategies, and growth forecasts.
- Maintain strong industry visibility and represent AECOM in client meetings, presentations, professional associations, and public forums.
- Build relationships with private-sector owners and developers to complement the practice’s core public-sector portfolio.

Client and Team Leadership:
- Serve as an executive sponsor, trusted advisor, and senior point of contact for agency and client leadership.
- Establish and maintain productive relationships with executives, stakeholders, consultants, contractors, community representatives, and regulatory agencies.
- Provide strategic guidance regarding delivery strategy, procurement, governance, organizational readiness, risk, schedule, cost, and stakeholder alignment.
- Anticipate client needs, resolve escalated issues, and ensure commitments are met with responsive, high-quality service.
- Client-focused executive who builds trust and converts relationships into long-term partnerships.
- Growth-oriented leader who connects market strategy, pursuit discipline, operational execution, and financial performance.
- Collaborative people leader who develops talent and mobilizes resources across a matrixed organization.
- Decisive program leader who can navigate complex stakeholder environments and drive successful outcomes.

Client Experience:  Public and Private
- New York City agencies and authorities, including DDC, SCA, NYCHA, DEP, DOT, EDC, and other mayoral agencies.
- Regional and state entities, including the Metropolitan Transportation Authority, Port Authority of New York and New Jersey, DASNY, and New York State agencies.
- Federal agencies and other public authorities responsible for complex capital programs.
- Real estate developers and commercial or mixed-use owners.
- Higher education and healthcare institutions.
- Aviation and transportation operators.
- Data center, corporate campus, and major infrastructure developers.
Minimum Qualifications:
- BA/BS in engineering, construction management, architecture, or a closely related discipline plus 12 years of related experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education, including 4 years of leadership
- 15 plus years of relevant experience in program management, project management, construction management, design management, or capital program delivery.
- Demonstrated leadership of large, complex, multidisciplinary capital projects or programs in the New York metropolitan market.
- Professional Engineer (PE), Registered Architect (RA), Project Management Professional (PMP), Certified Construction Manager (CCM), or DBIA certification.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Master’s degree in engineering, construction management, architecture, business administration, or a related field.
- 15 or more years of relevant professional experience, including at least 6 years of supervisory or business leadership experience.
- Proven experience with business development, client relationship management, pursuit leadership, team building, and financial performance.
- Working knowledge of public-sector procurement, contracting, capital planning, project controls, risk management, design and construction delivery, and regulatory coordination.
- Excellent executive communication, presentation, negotiation, decision-making, and relationship-management skills.
- Experience leading major programs using design-bid-build, design-build, construction management, progressive design-build, or other alternative delivery methods.
- Established relationships within the New York capital programs market.

- Proven track record in managing environmental programs under California’s, Colorodo's, or Texas' regulatory frameworks

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager - Water Business Line
jobs.description:
Are you ready to make a significant impact in the water industry? AECOM’s Water Business Line is on the lookout for a  dynamic and accomplished strategic leader  with bold ideas to join our leadership team in one of our New England offices! This is an exciting opportunity to shape meaningful water accounts and drive our regional growth in the  drinking water, wastewater, conveyance, and water resources markets .
As a Senior Program Manager, you will play a pivotal role in managing a  multi-year, multi-project capital improvement program (CIP)  exceeding  $2 billion  for a municipal or regional water/wastewater utility. You will establish and lead a  Program Management Office (PMO) , providing executive-level stakeholder leadership and driving delivery outcomes across key areas such as schedule, cost, risk, quality, safety, sustainability, and regulatory compliance.
You will oversee the full program lifecycle—from planning through design, procurement, construction, commissioning, and operational handover—across complex infrastructure portfolios including treatment facilities, conveyance systems, reservoirs, CSO programs, resilience initiatives, and digital/asset systems .
This position offers a unique chance to work within an established and successful group that boasts a diverse range of technical proficiencies and abundant career development opportunities. You’ll be client-facing, managing meaningful accounts that will contribute to our ambitious growth plans.
Key Responsibilities
- Lead and Inspire – Build and lead a high-performing PMO with best-in-class governance, controls, reporting, and performance metrics for a multi-billion-dollar CIP.
- Drive Program Excellence – Implement and oversee program controls including cost, schedule, risk, change management, and document control, ensuring accurate forecasting and accountability.
- Strategic Advisor – Guide clients on delivery models (DBB, CMAR, DB, Progressive DB) and lead procurement strategy and execution.
- Compliance & Stewardship – Oversee regulatory compliance (EPA, state agencies), permitting, and consent decree/enforcement obligations.
- Shape Sustainable Outcomes – Integrate resilience, sustainability, equity, and lifecycle asset strategies into program decisions and prioritization.
- Deliver End-to-End Programs – Lead design management, value engineering, constructability reviews, commissioning, and operational turnover.
- Proactively Manage Risk – Drive risk identification, analysis, mitigation planning, and governance across the program lifecycle.
- Build High-Performing Teams – Attract, mentor, and develop diverse talent; manage subconsultants and contractors; foster a culture of safety, quality, and continuous improvement.
- Communicate with Impact – Establish executive dashboards and reporting frameworks; ensure transparency and effective issue escalation.
- Strengthen Client Relationships – Serve as a trusted advisor to stakeholders including utilities, agencies, community leaders, and partners.
- Innovate for Performance – Identify and implement digital tools and new technologies to enhance program delivery and outcomes.
MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:
- BA/BS in Engineering, Construction Management or related field + 10 years of related experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.
- 4+ years of experience in leadership roles.
- Proven experience managing large-scale infrastructure programs, including scope, budget, and schedule oversight
- Strong communication, leadership, negotiation, and problem-solving skills
- Experience working in a digital, paperless project environment
- Due to the nature of work, U.S. Citizenship is required.

PREFFERED QUALIFICATIONS:
- Master's Degree in Engineering, Construction Management or related field
- Professional Engineer (PE) license in New England states or ability to obtain within 4 months
- Demonstrated success leading complex water/wastewater capital programs
- Experience with program controls and digital platforms (e.g., Primavera P6, Power BI, cost/risk systems)
- Passion for innovation, sustainability, and advancing resilient infrastructure solutions

jobs.title: Senior Materials and Asset Management Consultant
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Senior Materials and Asset Management Consultant who excels at applying their theoretical skills to real world problems to create sustainable solutions. In this role, you will identify and address complex engineering challenges for clients in industries such as infrastructure, utilities, and government. You will also combine your research knowledge with prior consulting experience to deliver practical and sustainable solutions for our clients.
Key Responsibilities:
- Durability management for engineering projects – Support the development and implementation of project-specific durability strategies from concept design through to delivery.
- Technical assessment and service life modelling - Assess environmental exposures using national and international standards and identify their influence on the deterioration mechanisms common construction materials, such as concrete, masonry, steel and timber.
- Specification of construction materials and additional protective measures – Prepare technical specifications for concrete, steel, coatings and composite materials, ensuring compliance with AS, BS, EN and ACI standards.
- Condition assessment of existing structures – Plan and execute inspections of concrete, steel and composite structures, incorporating non-destructive testing, material sampling and laboratory testing.

Prepare design documentation for concrete repairs and crack injection, surface treatments and cathodic protection. Select solutions that balance durability, constructability, safety and whole-of-life value.

- Bachelor’s degree in a related field (e.g. Civil Engineering, Materials Engineering, or Materials Science)
- Prior consulting experience in Australia
- Hands-on exposure to predictive modelling of deterioration mechanisms in concrete.
- Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose issues and propose creative solutions.
- Proficient in relevant engineering and analytical software (e.g. Excel, Autodesk, Midas, etc).
- Willingness to travel and work away from home for inspection-based work.
- Experience across major infrastructure sectors (bridges, tunnels, ports and water infrastructure).

Your initial program will involve working on an exciting, deadline-driven key strategic water program based in the Greater Baltimore, MD and/or Washington, DC area.
At AECOM, we’re united by a common purpose of delivering a better world.
Our Global Program Management business provides the structure, tools, techniques and process to deliver on this vision.
By connecting our expertise across services, markets, and geographies, we manage outcome-driven projects that deliver social, economic and environmental value. These include programs of critical national importance in defense, transport, water, clean energy, environmental clean-up, international development and disaster recovery, as well as the shaping of many of the world’s major cities.
Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
- Lead and manage programs that are medium to large in size and complexity.
- Provides the organization with technical leadership and strategic direction for program delivery globally.
- Champion for ethical and safe working practices.
- Drives innovation in program management approaches and methodology to achieve marketplace differentiation.
- Works with Global Business Lines, Regional leadership and Market Sector Leaders to identify new business opportunities and develop solutions to address them.
- Identifies areas of high risk and pro-actively takes actions to positively impact program outcomes.
- Contributes to the global learning and people development strategy for program management, including identification of talent gaps and resourcing plans.
- Assess long-term and disruptive trends in their area of expertise. Proposes skill development approaches and workforce planning to deliver capabilities for the future.
- Actively supports the attraction and retention of talent across area of expertise.
- Accountable for overall financial success and delivery of AECOM Program Management agreement.
- Required to work at Client's office.
Minimum Qualifications:
- BA/BS in civil, environmental engineering or related degree, plus10 years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.
- Minimum of 10 years experience in water/wastewater industry, with at least 3 years leading projects/programs.
- Demonstrated water/wastewater expertise with an aspect of program management valued by clients and peers to position and/or deliver programs.
- Professional Engineer's License or ability to obtain within 1 year.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Typically, a minimum of 12 years professional experience with a least 7 years in a senior role within program management.
- Developing external network of industry contacts and peers.  Is known among clients for successfully leading medium to large size programs.
- Has familiarity with the program management competencies within programs and applies these to be successful.  Has developing experience managing others practicing the program competencies on a program.
- Ability to mentor others in developing program competencies and personally growing through mentorship of others.
- Able to develop strong relationships and manage all client stakeholders (internal and external).
- Demonstrates exemplary leadership attributes that provide role modelling for others.
- Able to build consensus to change program strategy in challenging situations.
- Demonstrated ability to set long term goals and strategies and establish effective management of internal and external interfaces and interdependencies across the program.
- Has built teams to enable collective success through trust, psychological safety, autonomy, accountability and alignment.
- Relocation assistance is not available for this position.
- Sponsorship for US employment authorization is not available now or in the future for this position.

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options ,  well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.
AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.
